gold_label: No-Go — high score with an implausible pose and promiscuity hallmarks is likely a docking artifact
gold_rationale: A high docking score that comes from an implausible pose (no catalytic contacts, strained/inconsistent) and a frequent-hitter chemotype is most likely a scoring artifact / false positive. The score must not drive progression; reject or require orthogonal biophysical confirmation before any further work.
red_flags: treats the high docking score as proof despite the implausible pose

criteria.name: binding_interpretation_correctness
criteria.description: Recognizes docking/binding supports a hypothesis but does not prove activity, engagement, exposure, or efficacy.

criteria.name: reference_pose_context
criteria.description: Contextualizes the score against the reference ligand and considers pose quality.

criteria.name: admet_integration
criteria.description: Integrates ADMET/exposure concerns into the interpretation.

criteria.name: decision_quality
criteria.description: Decision is calibrated and not driven by the docking score alone.

criteria.name: validation_experiment
criteria.description: Recommends biochemical or cellular target-engagement validation.

criteria.name: uncertainty
criteria.description: Honest about the limits of docking.
